description: Client + docs for the async path: rewrite frontend/app.js from a single blocking fetch to submit-then-poll with real per-phase progress (preserving every render* helper and the textContent-only XSS boundary), and update the runnable examples (curl.sh, postman_collection.json) and the README to document the async flow as the recommended 503-free path while keeping the synchronous POST /query documented as the legacy fallback. Depends on FEAT-002 (the /jobs + /jobs/{id} contract) and FEAT-004 (openapi.yaml referenced by docs). Front end is validated with node --check only (no JS test runner).
steps: Rewrite frontend/app.js onSubmit per design 'Front end rewrite': remove the fake STAGES / startStages / clearStages timeline and the now-dead handleResponse; replace the stageTimer array with a single module-scoped pollHandle cleared by stopPolling(). onSubmit: validate non-empty text; disable the submit button; renderNotice('Submitting your question...', 'progress'); POST API_BASE + '/jobs' with body {query: text}; then dispatch on response.status FIRST (do NOT reuse handleResponse): 202 -> safeJson -> read job_id -> pollJob(job_id); 400 -> renderNotice(extractValidationMessage(await safeJson(response)), 'error') + stop; 429 -> rate-limit error notice; >=500 -> warming-up error notice; other -> generic unexpected-status error notice.

Add pollJob(jobId): GET API_BASE + '/jobs/' + encodeURIComponent(jobId) via a recursive setTimeout at POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 1200 with a cap MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS (~150, keep polling <=~180s) and linear backoff (+500ms, max 3000ms) on transient errors. Branch on HTTP status FIRST then on body.status: 404 -> terminal 'That request has expired or was not found.' error + stopPolling (NOT retried); >=500 -> transient, increment attempt + back off + retry to cap (error + stop at cap); other !ok -> terminal generic unexpected-status error + stopPolling; 200 -> safeJson -> switch body.status: queued/running -> renderNotice(body.progress.label + (body.progress.turn ? ' (turn ' + body.progress.turn + ')' : ''), 'progress') and schedule next poll (not terminal); succeeded -> renderResult(body.result) + stopPolling; failed -> renderNotice('The service could not complete your request. Please try again.', 'error') + stopPolling; other/absent body.status -> 'Unexpected response from the service.' error + stopPolling. A rejected fetch (network/CORS) -> increment attempt + back off + retry to cap. ONLY >=500 and a rejected fetch are retried; everything else is terminal.

Add stopPolling(): clears pollHandle (clearTimeout) and re-enables the submit button exactly once; call it on every terminal/cap/error path and after a submit failure (finally-equivalent). KEEP renderResult and all render*/makeBadge/sentimentClass/moodClass builders, extractValidationMessage, safeJson, renderNotice, warmUp (still pings /health), and the init placeholder guard intact (textContent-only XSS boundary unchanged). config.js is unchanged.

docs/examples/curl.sh: add an async section (submit -> poll loop -> print terminal body) using the design's python3 -c job-id and status parse and a `for _ in $(seq 1 150)` iteration cap that breaks on status succeeded|failed, keeping the standalone synchronous POST /query example beneath it. Keep `set -euo pipefail` and the `: "${API_URL:?...}"` guard; document that async is the 503-free path. Hyphens, never em dashes.

docs/examples/postman_collection.json: add a `POST {{API_URL}}/jobs` request (body {"query": "..."}) with a Postman test script that parses the response and saves job_id into a collection variable, and a `GET {{API_URL}}/jobs/{{job_id}}` request. Keep the existing /query requests.

README.md: in the Query section (around the `export API_URL=...izizrxgasb...` block and the CloudFront front-end subsection) document the async submit-then-poll flow (POST /jobs -> poll /jobs/{id}) as the recommended path and keep POST /query documented as the still-available synchronous route; keep GET /health and the CloudFront URL https://d2scp65e5pkne3.cloudfront.net accurate (the front end now uses the async path). In section 8, change the 30s-integration-timeout 503 bullet to state that the async path (202 + poll) REMOVES the 30s-wall 503 by decoupling the loop from the request window, noting synchronous POST /query remains available as a legacy fallback that can still hit the 30s wall on heavy queries. Keep the gateway id/base URL references accurate. Hyphens, never em dashes.
acceptance_criteria: `node --check frontend/app.js` passes; app.js submits to POST /jobs, polls GET /jobs/{id} with a cap + backoff, renders real progress into the aria-live region, renders the terminal result via the unchanged renderResult, disables the button in-flight and re-enables it exactly once on terminate, and clears the poll timer on terminal/error — AC-12. handleResponse and the fake STAGES timeline are removed; all other render* helpers are intact.

docs/examples/curl.sh is a valid bash script (`bash -n` clean) demonstrating the async submit-then-poll flow plus the synchronous example; postman_collection.json is valid JSON with the two new /jobs requests; README documents the async flow as recommended and section 8 reflects that async removes the 30s-wall 503 (FR-8).
No em dashes in any changed docs/resource text.
